Space with a group action and a subgroup
\operatorname{Top}(Z,H)\ \simeq\ \operatorname{Top}(Z,G)/(Z\times G/H)
$G$ acts diagonally on $Z\times G/H$ (étale over $Z$ by $\mathrm{pr}_1$).
Functor: take the part of $F$ over $Z\times\{e\}$, stable under $H$.
The functors $f_!$, $f^!$

f\colon\mathcal E\to\mathcal F:\quad f^*\ \dashv\ f_*,\qquad f_!\ \dashv\ f^*\ \ (\text{if } f^*\text{ commutes with arbitrary inverse limits}),\qquad f_*\ \dashv\ f^!\ \ (\text{if } f_*\text{ commutes with direct limits})
Closed embedding $i\colon Y\to X$:
i_*\colon \mathbf{Ab}(Y)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\{F\in\mathbf{Ab}(X):\ F|_{X\setminus Y}=0\}
i_*\,i^!F\hookrightarrow F,\qquad \Gamma(U,i^!F)=\{s\in F(U):\ \operatorname{Supp}s\subset Y\cap U\}
Right derived functors of $i^!$: sheaves of local cohomology.
Open embedding $j\colon Y\to X$: $j_!$ left adjoint of $j^*$.
Sheaves of sets: étale space over $Y$ viewed over $X$; stalks empty outside $Y$ (not a group object).
\Gamma(U,j_!F)=\{\varphi\in F(U\cap Y):\ \operatorname{Supp}\varphi\ \text{closed in } U\}\ \subset F(U\cap Y)\quad(F\ \text{abelian})
$j_!F$ = the sheaf on $X$ restricting to $F$ on $Y$ and to the initial object (empty sheaf of sets, zero sheaf of groups) on $X\setminus Y$.
j_*(\varnothing)(U)=\varnothing(U\cap Y)=\begin{cases}\mathrm{pt}& U\cap Y=\varnothing\\ \varnothing&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}
f_*(\varnothing)=\varnothing\iff f(X)\ \text{dense}\quad(\text{dominating morphism})
Sites: local properties
$E\to X$ is locally trivial: $X=\bigcup U_i$ with $E|_{U_i}\simeq U_i\times F_i$.
Algebraic geometry: a property holds locally if it becomes true after base extension $K\to K'$ of a given type.
$X$ a torsor (principal homogeneous space) under a group scheme $G$ over $K$: $X(K')$ is empty or principal homogeneous under $G(K')$.
Locally trivial: $X_{K'}=X\times_KK'$ has a section, i.e. is non-empty, for some covering $K\to K'$.
Definition of a site
A site: a category $C$ with a notion of localization (“topology”).
